subject: 396 Main Street Bakery Proposal
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals continued multiple hearings due to a lack of quorum and approved a Section 6 finding to allow a bakery at 396 Main Street.

items.title: 4,000 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: The board voted to continue the Chapter 40B comprehensive permit petition for 4,000 Mystic Valley Parkway to April 12, 2023.

items.title: 93 Governors Avenue and 114 Mystic Avenue Continuances
items.summary: Due to a lack of quorum, the board voted to continue the variance request for 93 Governors Avenue and the special permit petition for 114 Mystic Avenue to April 6, 2023.

items.title: 436 Riverside Avenue, 45 Bowen Street, and 590 Boston Avenue Continuances
items.summary: The board voted to continue the petitions for 436 Riverside Avenue, 45 Bowen Street, and 590 Boston Avenue to the April 27, 2023 regular meeting due to a lack of quorum.

items.title: 396 Main Street Section 6 Finding
items.summary: The board approved a Section 6 finding allowing a European-style sourdough bakery to operate in a non-conforming commercial space at 396 Main Street, subject to a condition that the applicant implement adequate odor control measures.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Building Commissioner Bill Forte announced that the city is working on releasing its first color-coded interactive GIS zoning map.
